title: The suite is still red under v8 coverage on `main` after #5402 — shard 3/4 fails deterministically and the unsharded run leaves no `coverage/` at all
body:
Found while measuring both arms of the coverage lane for #5403, on `aa949ba2` — current `main`, the first commit carrying #5402's fix. Filed unassigned; **not** fixed in #5403's PR, which changes how the lane runs and not what it asserts.

## What was measured

Two independent runs of the same instrument, same commit, same runner class (`proto-5403-shard-coverage.yml` on branch `claude/issue-5403-proto`):

| leg | run 32387182880 | run 32387778786 |
|---|---|---|
| shard 1/4 | success | success |
| shard 2/4 | success | success |
| **shard 3/4** | **failure** (10 min 27 s) | **failure** (10 min 16 s) |
| shard 4/4 | success | success |
| unsharded whole suite | test step 39 min 51 s, then **artifact upload failed with `if-no-files-found: error`** | (second sample still running when this was filed) |

Two things follow, and the second is the one that matters:

1. **It is deterministic, not a flake** — the same shard, twice, on the same commit.
2. **It is not caused by sharding.** The unsharded arm of run 32387182880 produced *no `coverage/` directory at all*, which is exactly #5402's documented mechanism: `coverage.reportOnFailure` defaults to `false`, so the v8 provider deletes the reports directory whenever the run is red. A red unsharded run and a red shard are the same suite failing, not sharding changing an outcome.

So `Test (coverage)` on `main` still ends with Codecov receiving nothing. #5402 removed one cause (a duplicated full-repo parse that timed out); at least one more failure remains.

## What is NOT established here

⛔ **The failing test is not identified in this report.** The measuring session's egress proxy blocks the Actions log and artifact CDN, so the failure text could not be read from it — only job conclusions and step timings come back through the REST API. Anyone who can open a log has this in one click:

- https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/32387182880/job/96484418219 (shard 3/4, round 1)
- https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/32387778786/job/96486365206 (shard 3/4, round 2)

A cheap first move for whoever picks this up: shard 3/4 holds 431 of the 1726 (project, file) specs; its `scripts/__tests__` members do **not** include the repo-scanning gates (`check-package-self-import`, `check-phantom-dependencies`), so this is unlikely to be another instance of the #5402 parse-cost class.

## Why it is worth its own card

While this stands, the coverage number on the Codecov dashboard is frozen at whatever the last green push produced, and #5403's lane — correctly — refuses to upload a report merged from a red shard. The lane becoming loud (also #5403) means this failure will now be *visible* rather than silent, but visible is not fixed.
